en.title: Banks and cards
en.summary: Accounts, debit and credit cards, and what to do if one is lost.

paragraphs: Banking is full of fixed phrases. This lesson describes the types of account and card and teaches you what to say when something goes wrong.
A customer is calling her bank in London because she cannot find her card.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Hello, I've lost my debit card.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. I'll block it now. Have you checked your account for strange payments?

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Yes, there are none, but I used the card this morning.

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Thank you. I'll also order a new card, which will arrive within five working days.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: Can I use my phone to pay in the meantime?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: Yes, if you have added your card to your mobile wallet.

lines.speaker: Customer
lines.text: I have. Do I need to change my PIN?

lines.speaker: Agent
lines.text: You'll choose a new one when the card arrives.

paragraphs: **1. The present perfect reports a recent event with a present result.** I've lost my card explains why I cannot pay now. See Introduction to Grammar: Past tenses.

blocks.html:
FormExample
have lostI have lost my card.
has been blockedThe card has been blocked.
have you checked...?Have you checked your account?
has arrivedThe new card has arrived.

paragraphs: **2. Will for decisions and arrangements.** The agent uses will for what she is going to do and for what happens next. See Introduction to Grammar: Future and other tenses.

blocks.html:
FormExample
I'll + verbI'll block it now.
will arriveIt will arrive within five days.
you'll + verbYou'll choose a new PIN.
won'tIt won't take long.

items: A debit card takes money straight from your account; a credit card lets you borrow.
Never share your PIN or your password.
Contactless means you tap the card instead of entering a PIN.
A mobile wallet stores your card details on a phone.

paragraphs: Most banks now have phone apps in which you can block a lost card immediately. Banks will never ask for your full PIN by phone or e-mail, so report such messages as fraud.
